Package com.csse3200.game.encounters.integration

Class EncounterFlowController

java.lang.Object
com.csse3200.game.encounters.integration.EncounterFlowController
All Implemented Interfaces:
EncounterCallback
public final class EncounterFlowController extends Object implements EncounterCallback
Entry point for the Map-to-Encounter-to-Map lifecycle.

The controller permits one active encounter, creates Chance and Shop sessions with the real integration gateways, and forwards completion to the Map exactly once for the active node.
